open_decisions.question: TSTVAL00 is a confirmed test tool (test-validation driver: routes by TEST-TYPE 'FUNCTIONAL' / 'INTEGRATE' / 'PERFORM' / 'ERROR', BR-126; computes 'WS-SUCCESS-RATE = (WS-TESTS-PASSED / WS-TOTAL-TESTS) * 100', BR-127). Is TSTVAL00 modernised, retired, replaced by a framework test harness, or kept as test tooling?

TSTVAL00 is classified test_tool (confirmed): classified as test_tool (confirmed); a human must decide whether it is in modernisation scope. Keep it in the modernisation scope (resolved_no_change) or exclude it (excluded_from_scope)?

Ten elementary level-01 FD/WS items have no permanent Field ID (PORTTRAN WS-EOF-FLAG, TSTGEN00 SEED-RECORD, TSTVAL00 EXPECTED-RECORD/ACTUAL-RECORD/REPORT-RECORD, UTLMNT00 ARCHIVE-RECORD/REPORT-RECORD, UTLVAL00 ERROR-RECORD, FILEHNDL INPUT-RECORD/OUTPUT-RECORD). Should the reverse data agent register Field IDs for record-level elementary items so their Java types can be fixed?

WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is referenced but declared nowhere in TSTGEN00, TSTVAL00, UTLMNT00, UTLMON00 and UTLVAL00 (it may have been expected from ERRHAND or RTNCODE). What is its intended layout and owning copybook?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

If TSTVAL00 is kept: GAP-018 - seven paragraphs (2200-RUN-FUNCTIONAL-TEST, 2300-RUN-INTEGRATION-TEST, 2400-RUN-PERFORMANCE-TEST, 2500-RUN-ERROR-TEST, 2600-VALIDATE-RESULTS, 2700-UPDATE-METRICS, 2800-WRITE-TEST-DETAIL) are not declared; GAP-039 - WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is declared nowhere; GAP-079 - test metrics are never updated, so the success-rate COMPUTE (line 212) may divide by zero. Can the full source be located, or is the tool unfinished?

GAP-092 (medium, DIAGRAM_RENDER_UNVERIFIED) is not addressed by any decision or requirement: Visual rendering of the 65 Mermaid diagrams is unverified. Acknowledge it as a known limitation (resolved_no_change) or exclude the affected units?

GAP-104 (low, DIAGRAM_INCOMPLETE) is not addressed by any decision or requirement: COMP-UNRESOLVED: all seven edges are unsupported. Acknowledge it as a known limitation (resolved_no_change) or exclude the affected units?
